rationale: CO-29 on both lines asserts timely filing expired. However, the 277CA shows clearinghouse acceptance (A2) on 2025-01-27 — 8 days after the 2025-01-19 DOS — proving the claim was received well within any commercial filing window. Per reference 03, proof of accepted submission inside the window triggers appeal to dispute the receipt date. N211 is a Medicare-context remark and does not extinguish commercial appeal rights.
